rv.q: I’m not convinced it all fits together that well, though.
It’s perfectly theatrical and impeccably put together, which is what really allows for the serious and impossible questions at the heart of the play to be properly examined.
Of course, a short show is also inevitably a bit superficial and this is true here too.
Lie Low is a riveting play that left me speechless.
Lie Low is a thought-provoking invitation to explore the complexities of sexual assault in a post-#MeToo era.

cn.t: This intense Irish two-hander about trauma and assault divides critics with its unsettling absurdist approach. Most praise its dark power and clever storytelling, though some question what new ground it breaks.
